title: Takaichi Cabinet Retains High Approval Ratings Despite Scandal and Legislative Strain
detail: Despite the smear-campaign controversy, a fracturing coalition with Ishin no Kai, and a turbulent final stretch of the 150-day Diet session, Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi's Cabinet approval ratings remained close to levels recorded when the session convened in February 2026. Polls published this month by two Japanese broadcasters put support at 58% and 65.9% respectively, underscoring durable public backing for Japan's first female prime minister as she pushes her defense buildup and economic agenda.

media.caption: Takaichi Cabinet approval ratings hold near session-opening levels
